name: Effigy Mounds National Monument
story: Effigy Mounds National Monument covers 2,526 acres in northeastern Iowa. It preserves more than 200 prehistoric mounds built by pre-Columbian Mound Builder cultures. Some of these effigy mounds are shaped like animals.
matters: The monument is located in the Driftless Area, a region that escaped glaciation during the last ice age. It is adjacent to several wildlife refuges and state forests.
